reference: Bash builtin metadata is checked against the documented bash-os loadable contract. No safe matching GNU reboot CLI oracle exists: the host reboot utility is a system action and its option semantics differ. Real reboot syscall behavior is deferred to a reviewed syscall mock.
coverage: Bash registration/help metadata only; no reboot invocation executes.
Deferred dry-run flag orders, ordinary/forced syscall dispatch, sync ordering and errno handling.
exclusions: Every reboot invocation, including -n, is deferred under the explicit command prohibition; require a future disposable VM and fail-closed syscall recorder. Metadata passes do not cover reboot operations.

cases.purpose: Use Bash type metadata to verify that reboot is registered as a builtin without invoking the operation.
Check the help text against the documented usage, flag meanings, and direct reboot(2) contract without requesting a reboot.
cases.script:
help_text=$(help reboot)
[[ $help_text == *'Reboot the system.'* ]]
[[ $help_text == *'reboot [-f] [-n]'* ]]
[[ $help_text == *'-f: skip sync'* ]]
[[ $help_text == *'-n: dry run'* ]]
[[ $help_text == *'Calls reboot(2) directly'* ]]
[[ $help_text == *'does not change runlevel or write accounting records.'* ]]
printf 'help contract: ok\n'
